title: Not Enough Flowers
description: A simple mod that adds more flowers for your builds!
body:
![Not Enough Flowers header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/146f66cb79492d2737547d467380e29c5d47a876.png)
This mod is part of the "Not Enough" series, being a new mod which adds 38 new flowers that all can be used in sus stew, be put into flower pots, and be turned to new ways to make dyes, alongside 4 new food items. 1. Reverence Berry which is the heart of every other recipe, it is made with 2 flowers of any kind and a glow berry and you get 4. They are also makeable by growing them like glow berries, and they give saturation for 15 seconds. 2. Reverence Stem, which is what is leftover from the Reverence Berry, by crafting it with a glowberry you will get back the Reverence Berry, allowing them to be recyclable. 3. Golden Reverence Berry, a spin-off inspired from the Golden Apple, this item is made with gold and the Reverence Berry in the middle, and gives better effects. 4. Bowl of Reverence Berries, by slapping 8 Reverence Berries onto a bowl you get the ultimate food source, however it gives glowing as well so not the best to eat when trying to hide. You will need bundles enabled for this mod to work as the way to obtain these flowers is via the Flower Bundle, and that is craftable with the bundle item. Growable Reverence Berries! ![Growable Reverence Berries (textures by Admiral_M_10k)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/868afb45ba2fd21b61d97fcccd4eb3d63183c68f.jpeg) All 38 new flowers and their potted versions! ![All 38 flowers and their potted versions (Textures by 8bitgunner)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09c26588cd8a0f3448a05a2ecb34f2b47757c052.jpeg) The four Reverence Food Items added! ![The 4 Reverence Food Items (Textures by Killerkrow)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0557bce93bd1a3f0d30e77a227343d4c0f1c5b9a.jpeg)
For Devs If you want your item added to the Flower Bundle when normal right clicking (aka when you exclusively get flowers from NEF) add your desired items or blocks to the #nef:nef_flower tag and they will be thrown in
- **Q. Will you ever port to Forge?** - A. No, I no longer support Forge Versions. If you wish to, contact me via the K Studios Development discord server and we can talk about it. The Forge Versions of this mod remain on this page for archive reasons only. - **Q. Backport or forward port?** - A. Maybe if my time allows it, I mod mainly for the versions I play so I likely won't be backporting or forward porting unless I play for that version. - **Q. Why isn't this on CurseForge?** - A. I do not want my mods to be associated with that site or Overwolf.
